top_news.title: Bounded Personas Match Retrieval on Classification but Not Regression for a Frozen Agent
top_news.dek: Distilled personas match retrieval-based methods for classification tasks but underperform in regression for frozen language agents.
top_news.brief: Researchers compared retrieval-based history management against distilled natural-language personas. While distillation offers lower latency and query independence, it struggles to maintain accuracy in regression tasks compared to retrieval, which pulls specific past interactions into the prompt.
top_news.image_alt: Comparison chart showing performance gap between retrieval and distillation methods

top_news.title: Which tools do Claude, Codex and Cursor choose? We measured 17k runs to find out
top_news.dek: An analysis of 17,000 coding agent sessions reveals how models like Claude and Cursor select third-party tools.
top_news.brief: The study examines how AI coding agents choose services and libraries when tasked with implementation. It highlights the growing influence of agents in the software supply chain, as they increasingly act as the primary decision-makers for selecting infrastructure and dependencies.
top_news.image_alt: Data visualization of tool selection frequency by AI coding agents

top_news.title: Deepseek plans the largest known Huawei chip cluster with 160,000 processors in Inner Mongolia
top_news.dek: Deepseek plans to deploy 160,000 Huawei Ascend-950DT chips in Inner Mongolia for inference-only workloads.
top_news.brief: Deepseek is planning a massive data center deployment using 160,000 Huawei Ascend-950DT processors. The cluster is intended exclusively for inference, while the company continues to rely on Nvidia hardware for model training. Production constraints at Huawei may delay the full rollout for over a year.

top_news.title: Run agent-driven Amazon SageMaker HyperPod operations with InstantStart
top_news.dek: AWS introduced HyperPod InstantStart, an open-source control plane for agent-driven SageMaker HyperPod operations.
top_news.brief: HyperPod InstantStart integrates Amazon EKS orchestration with SageMaker HyperPod to automate complex infrastructure tasks. It provides a unified interface for AI agents to manage cluster bootstrapping, capacity provisioning, training, and inference, reducing operational friction in multi-step foundation model workflows.

top_news.title: Using machine learning on my Guitar Hero Controller
top_news.dek: A developer explores using machine learning to optimize 'rakestrumming' techniques on Guitar Hero controllers.
top_news.brief: The project investigates the mechanics of 'rakestrumming,' a competitive Guitar Hero technique that allows for higher input frequency. By analyzing controller input patterns, the author explores how machine learning can be applied to automate or refine these high-speed strumming motions on standard hardware.
top_news.image_alt: Guitar Hero controller with custom input sensors

primary.title: Counterexamples as Feedback for Agent Self-Correction
primary.summary: Single-turn code-generation metrics understate a central property of deployed agents: whether they can repair a wrong artifact after receiving concrete feedback. This paper presents A-CEGIS, a lightweight framework that uses counterexamples as feedback for evaluating multi-turn refinement in natural-language-to-regex synthesis. An agent proposes a regex, a deterministic oracle checks it under full-match semantics, and compact false-positive or false-negative witnesses guide the next turn. primary.summary: OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra is drawing contradictory benchmark verdicts. Epoch AI puts it out in front with 169 points, while Artificial Analysis rates it no better than its predecessor and behind Claude Fable 5.1. The biggest surprise comes from ARC-AGI-3, where Astra works more efficiently than the average human for the first time. ARC Prize chief François Chollet doesn't call this proof of AGI, but he does see the progress running "twice as fast" as he expected, and he's moving up his AGI forecast.
